evaluator.exp: range reduction by powers of two: k = round(a/ln2), exp(a) = 2^k * sum_{i<=T} r^i/i!, r = a - k*ln2
evaluator.ln: binary normalization: b = 2^e*m, m in [1,2), ln(b) = e*ln2 + 2*sum_{j<T} z^(2j+1)/(2j+1), z = (m-1)/(m+1)

ln_domain_configurations.strict: PRIMARY, the literal preregistered evaluator: ln of a non-positive representable is a DOMAIN trap
ln_domain_configurations.extended: SECONDARY, added by the harness: two infinity sentinels with mpmath's conventions, so that the precision question is askable on constructions whose route passes through ln(0) = -inf (see RESULT deviation D2)

routing.rule: a point is real-route iff max|Im| along the whole route < gate

no_simplification.configuration: extended/nearest -- the strict configuration traps on eml_mul everywhere (ln(0) in the additive inverse), so the comparison would be vacuous there
